name: Varak Chain-Magistrate
firstAppearance: Campaign 02: Trial of the Celestial Heights
lore: Varak serves the Infernal Dominion as a chain-magistrate — a formal, transactional demon who is dangerous because he is often truthful. He oversees binding contracts, names the cost before the cruelty, and carries an iron chain of office and a black ledger. His living ash skin cracks with glowing embers, and curved black iron horns mark him as a creature of hell.
personality: Formal, transactional, precise. Dangerous because he is often truthful.
physicalDescription: Living ash skin with prominent glowing ember cracks. Curved black iron horns. Hellfire-red eyes. Sharp fanged features. Iron-plate armor over a crimson scholar coat with chains of office. Clawed hands and feet. Carries an iron chain and black ledger.
gameplayFunction: Rule explanation, deployment restriction voice, Empyrean codex source.
